description: This file defines the 'OrderStatus' class within the Opencart catalog module, providing methods to retrieve individual and multiple order status records from the database, including caching for multiple records.

classes.name: OrderStatus
classes.description: Provides methods to retrieve order status data from the database, including individual status retrieval and listing all statuses with caching.

methods.name: getOrderStatus
methods.description: Fetches a specific order status record based on the provided order_status_id from the database.

methods.name: getOrderStatuses
methods.description: Retrieves all order status records for the current language, utilizing caching for improved performance.
